title: Documents
intro: Your documents are private. Only you can open them.
uploadHint: Choose a file from your phone
emptyHint: Tap Add document to save your first file.
deleteHint: You will be asked to confirm before anything is deleted.
deleteConfirmBody: “{{name}}” will be permanently deleted. The stored file and the information the app keeps about the document are removed and cannot be restored.

errors.not-authenticated: You need to be signed in to save documents.
errors.invalid-file: That file could not be used. It needs a name and must be under 25 MB.
errors.upload-failed: The document was not saved. Check your connection and try again.
errors.metadata-failed: The document was not saved completely. Please try again.
errors.open-failed: The document could not be opened right now. Please try again.

deleteErrors.not-authenticated: You need to be signed in to delete documents.
deleteErrors.not-found: That document could not be found.
deleteErrors.invalid-response: The document was not deleted. Please try again.
deleteErrors.delete-incomplete: The deletion could not be confirmed. The document is still in your list — please try again.
